description: TCT compact JWS whose protected header carries `alg: none` (with a syntactically well-formed 86-char third segment, so the failure is the alg pin and not segment syntax) MUST be rejected with TOKEN_ALG_MISMATCH (RFC-AITP-0005 §7.2 step 3; RFC-AITP-0001 §5.4.5). The sole acceptable `alg` is derived from the issuer's AID — `EdDSA` for the Ed25519 `iss` here — and any other header value, including `none` in any capitalization, MUST be rejected before signature verification.

expected.rationale: Header is {"alg":"none","typ":"aitp-tct+jwt"}. The `typ` check (step 2) passes; the `alg` pin (step 3) rejects `none` before any signature or claims processing.
